description: ciris-binary-manifest/1 known answers (FSD-008 §6, CC 3.1.2.1 as accepted 2026-11-22): valid blobs with and without the inline table, functions_root per leaf count, and refusals by token.
merkle_rule: CC 3.1.2 (part_3_the_namespace.md v1.0-rc22-pre3 lines 57, 106, 108): leaves in name byte order; leaf SHA-256(0x00 || CDE({name, offset, size, hash})); node SHA-256(0x01 || l || r); pad by repeating the last leaf to the next power of two.

refusals.description: A member the blob does not admit.
A typ: the blob is not a signed object.
No offset metadata rides the blob (Q16).
A function entry with a member it does not admit (first_bytes).
The entry repeats its name: the map key is the name.
A function entry with no offset.
A function entry with no size.
A function entry with no hash.
format is read before the member set: another format with an unknown member is the wrong format.
No format and an unknown member: format is read first.
The top level is an array.
Map keys in insertion order, not the bytewise order of their encodings (format before tool).
The top-level map head in a non-shortest form (0xb8 0x09).
An offset of 0x1234 written with an eight-byte head.
An offset written as a double (1.5).
binary_hash with the sha256: prefix of the JSON manifests.
A size as a tag-4 decimal (1.5): normalised, so deterministic, but not a uint.
A function hash with the sha256: prefix.
A function keyed by an integer.
A function with an empty name.
functions_root differs from the inline table's root.
One entry's size changed under the same root.
A root computed over the leaves in CDE key order instead of name byte order.
A 3-leaf root under RFC 6962's split instead of last-leaf padding.
A blob of 1048577 bytes: refused before decoding.
A blob of exactly 1048576 bytes is decoded (and refused for its long tool).
